Class VehicleRepository

java.lang.Object
najah.eng.Application.Persistence.VehicleRepository
public class VehicleRepository extends Object
Provides file-based persistence operations for vehicles.

The repository reads vehicle records from a comma-separated text file, creates vehicle objects through VehicleFactory, searches for vehicles, and updates vehicle statuses.

      The default file is located at src/main/resources/vehicles.txt.

  • Method Details

    • findAvailableVehicles

      public ArrayList<Vehicle> findAvailableVehicles()
      Reads and returns all vehicles whose status is Available.

      Invalid or malformed records are ignored. When the file does not exist or cannot be read, an empty list is returned.

      Returns:
      a list containing the available vehicles

    • findById

      public Vehicle findById(String vehicleId)
      Searches for a vehicle using its unique identifier.
      Parameters:
      vehicleId - the identifier of the vehicle to find
      Returns:
      the matching vehicle, or null when no matching vehicle is found

    • updateStatus

      public boolean updateStatus(String vehicleId, String newStatus)
      Updates the status of the vehicle with the supplied identifier.

      The complete vehicles file is rewritten after the matching vehicle record has been updated.

      Parameters:
      vehicleId - the identifier of the vehicle to update
      newStatus - the new status to store
      Returns:
      true when the vehicle is found and updated; otherwise false

    • createVehicle

      private Vehicle createVehicle(String line)
      Converts one text-file record into a vehicle object.

      A valid vehicle record must contain four comma-separated values: ID, name, type, and status.

      Parameters:
      line - the text-file record to convert
      Returns:
      the created vehicle, or null when the record is empty or malformed
